pageDescription: Find large files and review their purpose and risk before cleaning
scanIncomplete: Scan cancelled. Partial results are read-only. Complete a new scan before deleting.
operationFailed: Operation did not complete. Please scan again and retry.
safetyNotice: Labels are path and file-type hints, not guarantees. Protected files cannot be selected; review unknown files individually. File size is not reclaimable space: virtual disks and shared blocks differ. Recycled files still use disk space.

reasons.system: System or application file. Deleting it may prevent software from working.
reasons.virtual-disk: Virtual machine or container disk that may hold projects and databases. Manage it in its own software.
reasons.database: Database or account data. Clean through the owning application, not here.
reasons.app-data: Application or automation data that may contain sign-in state, settings and work history.
reasons.backup: Backup: keep until another recoverable copy is confirmed.
reasons.cache: Recognized cache unchanged for over 7 days. Close its application and check for offline content first; files may be downloaded again.
reasons.recent-cache: Recently modified cache. Close its application and confirm it is no longer needed.
reasons.installer: Possible update installer. Confirm the update finished and rollback is not needed.
reasons.browser-model: Browser model. Removing it may affect offline features and trigger another download.
reasons.unknown: Purpose unknown; may be personal or business data. Open its location and review first.

confirmRecycleDesc: {{count}} files (logical size {{size}}) will move to the recycle bin. Review each file first; this does not free disk space yet.
confirmPermanentDesc: {{count}} files (logical size {{size}}) will be permanently deleted. Confirm they are unneeded and backed up. This cannot be undone; reclaimed space may differ.
deleteSuccess: Deleted {{count}} files (logical size {{size}}); actual disk space recovered may differ
recycleSuccess: Moved {{count}} files ({{size}}) to the recycle bin. Review and empty it to free space.
emptyDescription: No files matching the minimum size were found.
idleDescription: Select a directory to scan for large files that may be wasting disk space.
